notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least three additional creatures with flying.
description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Aven Gagglemaster with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 12 life.
Pay 12 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Pay {1} to untap Staff of Domination and {3} and tap Staff of Domination to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
